newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Oil president Edelman resigns.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Oil president Edelman resigns.

text.p: Snyder Oil Corp said on Thursday that Thomas Edelman has resigned as president but will continue as chairman and chief executive at Snyder's 74 percent owned affiliate, Patina Oil & Gas Corp.
The company said chairman John Snyder will assume the additional title of president on an interim basis.
Snyder Oil also said it has initiated a search to fill Edelman's position.
Snyder Oil said Edelman's interest in reducing his role had been under discussion for some period, adding that Edelman plans to dedicate additional time to Patina Oil.
